title: Pinned pre-image fingerprint deliberately disagrees with the patch it names
synthetic_rationale: Exercises the runner's fail-closed path: a mutant record whose pinned pre_image_fingerprint does not match what its own patch file hashes to (simulating a patch edited, or a record hand-edited, since it was pinned). The runner must refuse to test anything and report invalid-transform before the patch is applied or any detector ever runs, never silently proceed. Not a per-head query mutation.
notes: pre_image_fingerprint above is deliberately wrong (64 zero characters — well-formed SHA-256 hex, simulating a stale-but-plausible pin rather than a malformed one) — this record's entire purpose is to prove the mismatch is caught before the patch is applied or any detector ever runs. It is the one record `just semantic-mutant-repin` must never be run on: re-pinning it would make it a duplicate of MUTANT-SYNTH-KILLED-INVERT and erase the path it exists to exercise.
